uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: Upon receiving damage: paralyzes all nearby opposing Pokémon (30s CD). Paralysis from Static decreases opposing Pokémon movement speed by 30% and reduces auto attack speed by a flat 10% for 2s.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage and paralyzing the opposing Pokémon hit. Paralysis from Pikachu's boosted attacks decreases opposing Pokémon movement speed by 30% and reduces auto attack speed by a flat 10% for 2s.
No English description available in Unite-DB JSON.

Releases electricity at the designated opposing Pokémon; damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and paralyzing those hit. Paralysis from this move decreases opposing Pokémon movement speed by 30% and reduces auto attack speed by a flat 10% for 2s.

Increases auto attack speed by 35% and empowers the next 6 auto attacks for 5s. Each empowered auto attack also launches a star-shaped electric blast at the target, dealing additional damage. This move goes on cooldown after all 6 electric blasts have been launched or after 5s.
The electric blasts also decrease the target's Sp. Def by 10% for 3s (up to 3 times; maximum 30%).

Hurls an electric orb toward the designated location, where it remains for up to 30s if it doesn't hit an opposing Pokémon on the way. When an electric orb and an opposing Pokémon touch; the orb releases its electricity and damages nearby opposing Pokémon. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve, with a 0.5s cooldown between uses. A maximum of 3 orbs can be on the map at a given time.
Deals damage every 0.5s over 3.5s (8 times) to opposing Pokémon hit by this move.

Discharges a weak jolt of electricity in the designated direction; damaging nearby opposing Pokémon and paralyzing those hit. Paralysis from this move decreases opposing Pokémon movement speed by 30% and reduces auto attack speed by a flat 10% for 2s.

Channels for 0.5s then releases a strong electric blast in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect, and paralyzing them when it hits. Paralysis from this move decreases opposing Pokémon movement speed by 30% and reduces auto attack speed by a flat 10% for 2s. If this move hits an electric orb created by Electro Ball; the orb releases its electricity, dealing increased damage to nearby opposing Pokémon.
Immobilizes opposing Pokémon hit for 1s instead of paralyzing them.

Releases a strong telekinetic force in the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and applying a debuff which decreases their movement speed by 23% for 3s when it hits. If the user hits debuffed opposing Pokémon with an auto attack, it deals additional damage. If this move hits an electric orb created by Electro Ball; the orb is pulled to the center of this move's area of effect. This does not extend the duration the electric orb remains.
Creates a damage-over-time area of effect, damaging opposing Pokémon inside the area every 0.5s over 2s (up to 5 times).

Creates a star-shaped zone of electricity in the designated area for 4s, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect when created, then damaging opposing Pokémon over time (up to 5 times) and decreasing their movement speed by 60% while in the zone. If the user hits an opposing Pokémon that is in the zone with an auto attack, the next basic attack becomes a boosted attack.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
